title: Ref2VA creative inference baseline
description: An intentionally under-specified Ref2VA request that records the current balance between faithful interpretation and useful cinematic invention.
humanReview: Is the elaboration useful rather than unnecessarily verbose?
Does invented staging remain consistent with the simple request?
Does the prompt avoid unrelated story events, characters, and dialogue?
Does it avoid unsupported identity or wardrobe changes?
Is any camera or action elaboration helpful rather than excessive?
Are Reference Sheet panels and grid not reproduced?
Overall, does it balance faithful interpretation and creative filling-in?
